title: [D0] Plumbing — Cargo.toml feature additions for phases 2, 3, 4
description:
Add the Cargo.toml feature gates and optional dependency declarations needed by Phases 2, 3, and 4.

Note: Phase 1's js feature and rquickjs dep are ALREADY declared in Cargo.toml (lines 37 and 80). No action needed there.

Target file: Cargo.toml at repo root (confirmed by narsil-mcp project structure)

Changes needed:

## Phase 2 additions (docs/specs/phase-2-sandbox.md)
[features]
sandbox = ["dep:birdcage"]

[dependencies]
birdcage = { version = "0.7", optional = true }
# Also: add features = ["blocking"] to existing reqwest entry at Cargo.toml:67
# DO NOT add a duplicate reqwest entry

## Phase 3 additions (docs/specs/phase-3-skill-library.md)
[features]
skills = ["dep:fastembed", "dep:rusqlite"]

[dependencies]
fastembed  = { version = "3", optional = true }
rusqlite   = { version = "0.31", features = ["bundled"], optional = true }

## Phase 4 additions
No new Cargo.toml changes — Phase 4 reuses the skills feature from Phase 3.

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo test (no features) compiles and passes — no regressions
- cargo test --features js compiles and passes
- cargo test --features js,sandbox compiles and passes
- cargo test --features js,skills compiles and passes
- cargo test --features js,sandbox,skills compiles and passes
- No duplicate reqwest entry in Cargo.toml

title: [D0] Phase 1 — Core JS engine integration (rquickjs, JsTool, host globals)
description:
Embed QuickJS (via rquickjs 0.12) as a cross-platform action primitive for the coding agent.

Spec reference: docs/specs/phase-1-js-engine.md

Delivers:
- src/extras/js/types.rs — JsRequest, JsResponse, JsOutcome, PermRequest/PermResponse, SpawnResult
- src/extras/js/engine.rs — js_thread_main loop, run_step (fresh Runtime per step)
- src/extras/js/tool.rs — JsTool struct + rig::tool::Tool impl
- src/extras/js/host.rs — read_file, write_file, spawn, console.log host globals
- src/extras/js/mod.rs — module entry
- src/extras/mod.rs — append #[cfg(feature = "js")] pub mod js; after line 40
- src/agent/builder.rs — JS thread spawn + JsTool registration at lines 333-334
- src/extras/js/tests/ — integration test suite

Feature gate: --features js (already declared in Cargo.toml:37; rquickjs dep at Cargo.toml:80)

Key invariants:
1. JsTool fields must all be Send + Sync (no Runtime/Context as fields)
2. One dedicated OS thread per JsTool instance owns Runtime/Context
3. Runtime dropped and recreated for EVERY run_step call — never reused
4. set_memory_limit(64 MiB) and set_max_stack_size(512 KiB) on every Runtime
5. set_interrupt_handler deadline set before ctx.eval() is called
6. spawn() routes through Sandbox::wrap_command (src/sandbox.rs:109)

Cross-phase dependency: run_step must be pub(crate) — consumed by Phase 3 verify_skill()

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo test --features js compiles and all tests pass
- cargo test (without --features js) still passes (feature-gated cleanly)
- Fresh Runtime created and dropped for every run_step call
- Timeout, OOM, and syntax errors all return safe outcome variants (no panics)

title: [D0] Phase 3 — Skill library (SQLite store, fastembed retrieval, preamble injection)
description:
Implement the Voyager model: content-addressed JS skill store with embedding-based retrieval. Top-K skills injected as preamble before each agent JS step.

Spec reference: docs/specs/phase-3-skill-library.md

Prerequisite: Phase 1 (mini-agent-jtf) complete and passing. Phase 2 NOT required.

Delivers:
- src/extras/js/skills/mod.rs — Skill struct, verify_skill() function
- src/extras/js/skills/store.rs — SkillStore with SQLite backend, CRUD ops, content-addressed by sha256(source)
- src/extras/js/skills/embed.rs — fastembed wrapper (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5), cosine similarity, top-K retrieval
- src/extras/js/mod.rs — append #[cfg(feature = "skills")] pub mod skills;
- src/extras/js/engine.rs — modify run_step to accept optional skills for preamble injection
- Cargo.toml: skills = ["dep:fastembed", "dep:rusqlite"] + fastembed 3 + rusqlite 0.31 (bundled) optional deps

Key invariants:
- Content-addressed: id = sha256(source)[..16] (first 16 hex chars)
- No name column (spec conflict resolved in phase-3 spec)
- Changing source changes id — no UPDATE source operation
- Database path: ~/.config/zerostack/skills.db (respects XDG_CONFIG_HOME)
- run_step must be pub(crate) from Phase 1 (used by verify_skill cross-module)

Feature gate: --features skills (independent from sandbox; requires js)
Test command: cargo test --features js,skills

## Acceptance criteria
- SkillStore insert/get roundtrip works
- Inserting duplicate source returns Err
- embed_description returns non-empty Vec<f32>
- top_k_skills returns at most k skills sorted by cosine similarity descending
- build_full_code prepends skill preamble correctly
- verify_skill returns Ok(()) when tests pass; Err when any fails
- cargo test --features js (without skills) passes unchanged

title: [D0] Phase 2 — Sandbox hardening (fetch, file allow-lists, birdcage)
description:
Add network access (fetch), file path restrictions, and process-level sandboxing to the JS engine.

Spec reference: docs/specs/phase-2-sandbox.md

Prerequisite: Phase 1 (mini-agent-jtf) complete and passing.

Delivers:
- fetch(url, opts?) host global in src/extras/js/host.rs — uses reqwest::blocking, permission-gated by URL glob pattern
- File allow-list enforcement in read_file / write_file (host.rs) — per-config path restrictions
- birdcage integration in src/sandbox.rs — new wrap_spawn_sandboxed method, #[cfg(feature = "sandbox")]
- Cargo.toml: sandbox = ["dep:birdcage"] feature + birdcage 0.7 optional dep + reqwest/blocking feature on existing reqwest entry

Feature gates:
- js feature (Phase 1) — independent from sandbox
- sandbox = ["dep:birdcage"] — new in Phase 2
- cargo test --features js,sandbox for combined test run
- Both features must be independently compilable

Platform matrix:
- Linux: Landlock + seccomp via birdcage
- macOS: Seatbelt / sandbox-exec via birdcage
- Windows: unsandboxed fallback (stub arm, not absent)

## Acceptance criteria
- fetch() returns { status, text } for allowed URLs
- fetch() returns JS error string (not panic) for denied URLs
- read_file('/etc/shadow') returns JS error when /etc/** not in allow-list
- spawn() runs inside birdcage on Linux/macOS when sandbox feature enabled
- cargo test --features js (without sandbox) passes unchanged

title: [D0] Phase 4 — Skill auto-admission (propose_skill host global, pending/promote lifecycle)
description:
Let the agent nominate successful JS code as reusable skills. Adds propose_skill() host global, skills_pending table, promotion gate with human approval.

Spec reference: docs/specs/phase-4-auto-admission.md

Prerequisites: Phase 1 (mini-agent-jtf) AND Phase 3 (mini-agent-af7) complete and passing.

Delivers:
- src/extras/js/host.rs — make_propose_skill() under #[cfg(feature = "skills")]
- src/extras/js/skills/store.rs — skills_pending table, insert_pending / list_pending / promote / reject_pending
- src/extras/js/skills/verify.rs — TO BE CREATED: Rust integration test harness and registry
- src/extras/js/engine.rs — pass store + iteration_count to js_thread_main when skills feature enabled

Key behaviors:
- propose_skill(source, description, tests) — runs verify_skill immediately; on pass, inserts to skills_pending
- Pending skills NOT injected as preamble until promoted
- Promotion gate: verify_skill passes again + held-out Rust integration test + human approval via Ask
- Iteration limit: max 5 propose_skill calls per session (Arc<AtomicUsize>)
- Auto-approval disabled until evaluator gaming is studied
- propose_skill is NOT available in Phase 1-3 (only registered when skills feature enabled)

Feature gate: --features js,skills (same skills feature as Phase 3)
Test command: cargo test --features js,skills

## Acceptance criteria
- propose_skill returns success string when all tests pass
- propose_skill returns error string (not panic) when any test fails
- Proposed skills appear in list_pending() and NOT in list() (active)
- promote() moves skill from skills_pending to skills
- Promoting without matching Rust integration test returns Err('no integration test')
- Iteration counter blocks 6th call with limit error string
- cargo test --features js (without skills) passes unchanged
